domain: Historical definitions in holomorphic Poisson geometry
research_goal: Compare each historical version's matrix column-selection rule, prescribed free-and-cofree submodule rank, and strongest operative named general-position assumption for the author's local-triviality conclusion.
structural_upgrade: Bounded official-history enumeration, historical full-text comparison, and same-version correction precedence. No claim of greater difficulty or deeper retrieval than the supplied old tasks.

cg.instruction:
Compare the general-position requirements in Ziv Ran's preprint first submitted in 2017 on Bogomolov unobstructedness for log-symplectic manifolds. Return a compact version-by-version table of its matrix definition and operative assumption for the local-triviality conclusion.

Use the official submission history as observed on 12 September 2026. Include every version listed through that date, using official version numbers rather than document compilation dates.

The selected conclusion is that deformations of the holomorphic Poisson pair (X, Pi) induce locally trivial deformations of its degeneracy divisor D. Use the main theorem for compact Kählerian X of dimension 2n >= 4. Use each version's own definition of log-symplectic and its wording for a divisor with local normal crossings. Do not require simple normal crossings or restrict to toric examples.

For each version, report the column-selection rule in its t-relative general-position definition for matrices M and N. Report the prescribed rank of the free and cofree submodule generated by those columns, keeping t symbolic. Also report the strongest named general-position assumption, including its numerical parameter, required for the selected conclusion after applying any erratum appended to that same version. If a stronger named condition includes a weaker one by definition, report only the stronger name. Do not apply later corrections retrospectively.

Report the author's stated requirements without assessing proofs or repairing definitions by inference. Exclude special-case results from this comparison. Ignore theorem renumbering, layout, compilation dates, and unrelated proof changes.

To carry out the comparison:
1. Identify the preprint and enumerate its official versions.
2. Read each version's matrix definition and main theorem.
3. Check that version for an appended correction and resolve the named assumption using its definition.
4. Encode the requested fields and order the version rows.
cg.output_format: Return only a pipe-separated table with header version|column_selection|free_cofree_rank|operative_assumption. Use one row per official version, including unchanged versions, sorted by ascending numerical version number. Do not merge equal rows or add a change-summary row; there is no tie selection. Write version as v followed by its number. For column_selection, use ANY_T for every selection of t columns from the concatenated matrices M and N, or MATCHED_T for every selection of t columns of M together with the same-index columns of N. Write free_cofree_rank as a symbolic expression in t, such as t or 2t. For operative_assumption, use the author's named condition with its numerical parameter. A version without an erratum uses its main statement. Use NONE only in operative_assumption when the complete version establishes that no named general-position assumption is required for this conclusion. Use UNKNOWN for inaccessible or ambiguous evidence in any non-key cell and retain its version row; never use NONE for missing evidence or for the entire table.
